inputProvenance: The init image for the second passes is the approved Phobos anhydrous residue master (source/anhydrous-residue.png), sent base64; no game or third-party imagery.

q2/q3/q4 ammonia stores.method: Pixels with hue 190-250 degrees, saturation >= 0.35 and value >= 0.35 (the nitrogen domes) are mapped by luminance onto a sulphur-yellow ramp; frame, clamps, band, hub and alpha unchanged. Sulphur yellow follows the gas-cylinder convention for toxic gases.

spent-salt-cake.method: per-pixel luminance map onto a cool grey-white salt ramp; alpha and pixel placement unchanged (the cake is the crust's clay fused with salt, so it shares the residue's silhouette)

request.description: ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical front or side faces. Draw one chunk of pale mineral salt crust seen from directly above: a single irregular angular lump of chalky off-white and pale cream crystalline salt, with a faint warm yellowish tint in places, small glinting white crystal facets, a few thin dark grey clay streaks and specks through it, a slightly brighter upper-left region and a greyer lower-right edge. Clearly a mined salt mineral, not ice, not food, not sugar, not bread. Original coarse pixel art, three-tone shading. Centre the complete silhouette on a transparent 64 x 64 canvas with 8-pixel margins. No text, numbers, symbols or logos.

attempts.review: A pinkish rounded pebble with a dark lower band that reads as a side face.
